blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: The appearance of a scene is determined by the albedo, roughness, metallicity and normal of every point on its surface, and by the light that reaches it, its irradiance. Recovering these intrinsics from images is ambiguous, and methods that predict them per pixel give the same surface point a different decomposition in every view. We introduce PointX, a simple feed-forward model that predicts intrinsics per 3D surface point instead. A multi-view transformer encodes a set of unposed images, and for any queried surface point, PointX pools the point's tokens across the views in which it appears and decodes the point's intrinsics once. Each point of a 3D reconstruction of the scene, such as a point cloud or a mesh, thus receives a single prediction, which is exactly consistent across views by construction and enables view-consistent relighting and editing. The same model also predicts per-view maps, from one image or many, by querying the point seen at every pixel. These maps agree across views up to the precision of the estimated geometry and correspondences. PointX is significantly more consistent than existing methods, while remaining competitive in accuracy from a single image and improving as views are added. Project page: https://pointx-paper.github.io/

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Inverse rendering decomposes an image into the inputs of a renderer: the albedo, normal, roughness and metallicity of every surface point, and the light that reaches it, its irradiance.
With these intrinsic properties [ 2 ] , a captured scene can be relit, its materials edited, or new objects inserted into it.
However, the decomposition is ambiguous, since the same pixel color has several valid explanations: a wall that appears red may be white under red light or red under white light. While recent methods [ 52 , 41 , 103 , 72 , 6 , 36 , 67 , 25 , 104 ] achieve accurate single-view predictions, a scene is usually captured in several images, or a video.
The same surface point appears in several of them, yet per-image methods resolve the ambiguity in each image independently, so the point receives a different decomposition in every view.
Applications using these intrinsics across multiple views then inherit this disagreement: a relit scene flickers from view to view, an edit made in one image does not carry over to the next, and materials texturing a reconstruction show seams.
blocks.zh:
反向渲染将一个图像分解成一个渲染器的输入:每个表面点的反照,正常,粗糙和金属,以及到达它的光,它的辐射.
有了这些内在属性[2],一个被捕获的场景可以被重新解析,其材料经过编辑,或者插入到其中的新物体.
然而,分解的模棱两可,因为相同的像素颜色有几种有效的解释:一面外观为红色的墙可能是在红光下白色的,或者在白光下为红色的. 虽然近代方法[52,41,103,72,6,36,67,25,104]实现了准确的单景预测,但一个场景通常被拍摄到多个图像,或者视频中.
在其中的数个中都出现了相同的表面点,然而每个图像中的每个图像的模糊度都独立地得到解决,因此该点在每一个视图中都会得到不同的分解.
使用这些内在的多个视图的应用程序继承了这一分歧:从视图到视图的重写场景闪烁器、用一个图像制作的编辑不延续到下一个图像,以及用于重建显示缝合的材料。

blocks.en:
One line of work addresses this inconsistency by attaching the intrinsics to a 3D representation of the scene, fitted per scene [ 111 , 31 , 106 , 23 , 56 , 65 ] or predicted by a network [ 53 , 35 , 73 , 109 ] , and rendering them into every view, so that all views show the same underlying intrinsics.
However, every view then inherits the errors of this representation, and per-scene fits take minutes to hours.
A second line of work drops the 3D representation.
Multi-view networks [ 98 , 54 , 14 ] compute the features of each view from all images through cross-view attention, and video models do the same across frames [ 55 , 20 , 85 , 104 ] .
Their predictions are more consistent than those of single-view networks, but each view is still decoded independently, so corresponding pixels of different views can still disagree.
A third line of work keeps the per-view predictions and reconciles them afterwards, through a multi-view consensus at test time [ 11 ] or a per-scene optimization [ 40 ] , which has to resolve the disagreement of separately predicted views.
Thus far, consistency has either required an explicit 3D representation, been encouraged through attention and training, or been enforced after the predictions are made.
blocks.zh:
一行工作解决了这种不一致的情况,将内在内容附在每一场景的立体表现上[111、31、106、23、56、65],或由一个网络预测[53、35、73、109],并将这些内容纳入各种观点,以便所有观点都显示同样的内在内容。
然而,每个视图都继承了这种表述的错误,而每个场景需要几分钟到几小时的时间。
第二行工作放弃了3D代表.
多景网络[98,54,14]通过交叉视点从所有图像中计算每个景点的特征,视频模型在跨帧时也做同样的[55,20,85,104].
他们的预测比单视图网络的预测更加一致,但每个视图仍然独立解码,因此不同观点的相应像素仍然可以有分歧.
第三行工作通过测试时间[11]或每个场景优化的多视图共识[40],保留了每个场景的预测,并在之后进行调和,这必须解决单独预测的观点的分歧.
迄今为止,一致性要么需要明确的三维表述,要么通过关注和培训加以鼓励,要么在预测之后强制执行。

blocks.en:
Our key insight is to predict intrinsic properties per surface point rather than per pixel.
We introduce PointX , a feed-forward model that takes one or several unposed images of a static scene and predicts the intrinsics of a query surface point using evidence from all views in which it appears.
A multi-view transformer, initialized from a feed-forward reconstruction model [ 90 ] , first computes a feature map for each image.
Given a query point in 3D or pixel space, we then find its correspondences across the input images and sample the feature maps at these locations.
A 3D point is projected into each image with cameras and depth, estimated by a frozen reconstruction model [ 90 ] or taken from any other source, and a pixel can also be matched across the images with a dense matcher [ 66 ] .
We pool these features into a single representation of the surface point, weighting each view by the confidence that the point is visible in it, and small MLP heads decode the point’s intrinsic properties from it only once.
The resulting prediction belongs to the point rather than to a view, making it consistent by construction.
The same model can predict properties directly for the points of a reconstruction, without having to fuse separate per-view predictions, or produce per-view maps by querying every pixel, which then agree across views as far as their correspondences do.
PointX also benefits directly from more accurate geometry and correspondences, such as those of a dense matcher, without retraining.
In Fig. 1 , PointX predicts the intrinsic properties of the points of a laser-scanned scene [ 74 ] , so that a light placed once or a material edited once produces consistent results across the input views.

blocks.en:
We evaluate PointX in three experiments.
First, with the geometry of the scene given, we query the surface points of rendered scenes [ 70 , 117 ] directly: PointX is competitive with or more accurate than baselines whose per-view predictions are averaged at each point, and has no disagreement between views to resolve.
Second, we measure the consistency of per-view maps at exact correspondences on laser-scanned real scenes [ 74 ] , where PointX is the most consistent.
Third, we measure prediction accuracy on rendered scenes and real photographs [ 96 ] : PointX is competitive with the state of the art from a single image, and becomes more accurate with every added image.
Ablations show that pooling the features of all views into a single representation per point brings this consistency at no cost in accuracy: decoding every pixel from its own features is equally accurate, but far less consistent.
blocks.zh:
我们在三个实验中评估了点X.
首先,在给出了场景的几何特征后,我们直接查询渲染场景的表面点[70,117]: 点X具有竞争力,或比基线更准确,其每个点的直视预测值均匀,对于需要解决的观点没有分歧.
第二,我们在激光扫描真实场景上精确对应测量每景地图的一致性[74],其中PointX是最一致的.
第三,我们测量所拍摄场景和真实照片的预测准确性[96]: PointX从单一的图像中与艺术状态竞争,随着每个新增的图像变得更加准确.
缩写显示,将所有观点的特征集中到每个点的单一表述中,可以不惜任何代价地准确性地带来这种一致性:将每个像素从自身特征中解码同样准确,但一致性要低得多.

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are: (1) a formulation that predicts intrinsic properties once per surface point rather than per pixel, and is consistent across views by construction; (2) PointX, a feed-forward model that implements it from one or several unposed images, and serves both per-point and per-view prediction; and (3) an evaluation of intrinsics on surface points, and of their consistency at exact correspondences on real scenes.
blocks.zh: 简而言之,我们的贡献是:(1)预测每个表面点而不是像素的内在性质,并且通过构造来表达各种观点的公式;(2)点X,一个从一个或几个未布置的图像中执行它的向导模型,同时服务于每个点和每个视图的预测;(3)对表面点上的内在性质及其在真实场景中精确对应的一致性的评价.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Intrinsic images [ 2 , 46 ] separate an image into reflectance and shading. Early methods relied on physical assumptions and hand-designed priors [ 28 , 95 , 86 , 24 , 1 ] ; later ones learned priors from human judgments [ 3 , 116 , 64 ] , rendered scenes [ 49 , 70 , 117 ] and time-lapse video [ 50 ] . Inverse rendering widens the output to materials and lighting for whole indoor scenes [ 75 , 52 , 94 , 118 , 117 ] . Generative models have recently raised single-image accuracy [ 15 , 41 , 103 , 72 , 6 , 36 , 67 , 8 , 85 ] , since they can resolve the ambiguity with a plausible sample. All of these methods predict single-view, per-pixel intrinsics.
blocks.zh: 内向图像[2,46]将一个图像分离成反射和阴影. 早期的方法依赖于物理假设和手工设计的前传[28,95,86,24,1];后来的方法从人类判断中吸取了前传[3,116,64],使场景[49,70,117]和时滞视频[50]. 反向渲染将输出扩大到材料和整个室内场景的照明[75、52、94、118、117]。 基因模型最近提高了单像精度[15,41,103,72,6,36,67,8,85],因为它们可以用一个可信的样本解决模糊性. 所有这些方法都预测单视,每像素内在.

blocks.en: The disagreement between views has been addressed in three ways. Intrinsic video and multi-view intrinsic images tie the reflectance along correspondences with a penalty, solved per sequence [ 44 , 43 , 42 , 100 , 21 , 4 , 16 , 63 ] ; later work used such sequences as a training signal for single-image networks [ 50 , 48 , 102 ] . Reconstruction-based inverse rendering attaches materials and lighting to a 3D representation, optimized per scene [ 108 , 81 , 5 , 111 , 112 , 99 , 31 , 106 , 97 , 23 , 56 , 29 , 65 , 40 ] or predicted by a network [ 110 , 53 , 35 , 73 , 109 ] , and renders it into every view; this is consistent by design, but every view inherits its errors. Most recently, multi-view and video networks exchange information across views through attention [ 54 , 98 , 14 , 55 , 20 ] , project predictions between frames [ 11 ] , or fine-tune with a consistency objective [ 98 ] . They are more consistent than single-image networks, but the maps of each view are still decoded independently, so corresponding pixels can disagree. We instead decode the intrinsics once per surface point.
blocks.zh: 不同观点的分歧通过三种方式解决. 内摄录影带和多视素内在影像将反射带与函授绑定,按顺序解决[44,43,42,100,21,4,16,63];后期作品将此类序列作为单像网络的培训信号[50,48,102]. 基于重建的反向渲染将材料和照明附加到一个3D代表器上,每个场景优化[108,81,5,111,112,99,31,106,97,23,56,29,65,40]或由一个网络预测[110,53,35,73,109],并使其成为每个视图;这在设计上是一致的,但每个视图都继承其错误. 最近,多视图和视频网络通过注意[54、98、14、55、20]、框架[11]之间的项目预测,或与一致性目标[98]进行微调,交流各种观点的信息。 它们比单像网络更加一致,但每个视图的地图仍然独立解码,因此相应的像素可以有分歧. 而我们每个表面点破解内在

blocks.en: Feed-forward reconstruction models [ 92 , 47 , 89 , 57 , 34 , 93 , 37 , 90 , 61 , 82 ] predict depth and cameras for a set of images or a video with a transformer that attends across views. We use one as our multi-view transformer, and a frozen copy to estimate the geometry that conditions it. Dense matchers [ 84 , 87 , 17 , 19 , 18 , 113 , 66 , 58 ] estimate a correspondence and its certainty for every pixel of an image pair without recovering 3D geometry, and point trackers [ 26 , 12 , 13 , 33 , 32 , 79 , 45 ] follow a pixel’s surface point through a video. In our framework, a track is the pixel at which one surface point is visible in each view, obtained by projecting a 3D point with this geometry or by matching a pixel across the images, which is more precise and what our per-view maps rely on.
blocks.zh: Feed-forward重建型号 [92, 47, 89, 57, 34, 93, 37, 90, 61, 82] 预测一组图像或带变压器的视频的深度和摄像头,这些图像和摄像头可跨视线观看. 我们用一个作为我们的多视图变压器, 和一个冷冻的拷贝来估计它的条件几何。 [84, 87, 17, 19, 18, 113, 66, 58] 对一对图像的每个像素没有恢复3D几何, 和点追踪器[26, 12, 13, 33, 32, 79, 45] 通过视频跟随一个像素的表面点进行通信及其确定性. 在我们的框架中,一个音轨是每个视图中一个表面点可见的像素,通过投影3D点与这个几何图案或者在图像之间匹配一个像素来获得,这个像素更精确,以及我们的每个视图地图所依赖的.

blocks.en: Pooling per-view features at a 3D point is a staple of generalizable view synthesis and reconstruction: pixelNeRF [ 101 ] averages them, IBRNet [ 91 ] and NeuRay [ 59 ] weight them by learned visibility, MVSNeRF [ 7 ] fuses them in a cost volume, transformers attend along epipolar lines [ 83 ] or over all view tokens without an explicit point [ 71 , 27 , 107 , 30 ] , and GenRecon [ 73 ] conditions a generative mesh model on their statistics. Our pooling follows these works: a visibility-weighted mean of the tokens of a surface point, decoded into intrinsic properties. A second line lifts per-view features or labels into a 3D field and consolidates their disagreements there [ 114 , 39 , 88 , 38 , 76 , 22 , 115 , 62 , 21 ] , at the cost of a per-scene optimization. We pool the tokens before decoding, so there are no per-view predictions to consolidate.
blocks.zh: 在3D点集合每个视图特征是通用视图合成与重建的主线:像素NERF[101]平均,IBRNet[91]和Neuray[59]通过学习可见度进行加权,MVSNERF[7]将它们装入成本量中,变压器沿着极线[83]或在所有视图标志上进行,没有明确点[71,27,107,30],以及GenRecon[73]在统计上规定一个基因网格模型。 我们的集合遵循这些作品: 表面点标志的能见度加权平均值, 解码为内在属性。 第二行将每个景点的特征或标签提升到一个3D字段,并巩固那里的分歧[114,39,88,38,76,22,115,62,21],以每个景点优化为代价. 在解码前我们把信物汇集起来,所以没有每个视图的预测可以合并.

blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: We introduce PointX, illustrated in Fig. 2 , a feed-forward transformer that takes a set of images of a scene and predicts the intrinsic properties of any queried surface point. Section 3.1 states the problem and how a surface point is located in the images, Sec. 3.2 describes the architecture, and Sec. 3.3 the training setup.

blocks.en: 3.2 Architecture
blocks.zh: 3.2 建筑结构

blocks.en: PointX consists of three parts ( Fig. 2 ): a multi-view transformer turns every image into a map of tokens, a pooling step reads one token per view along the track of the query and averages them into a single token, and MLP heads decode the intrinsic properties of the point from this token.

blocks.en:
We run VGGT- Ω \Omega [ 90 ] (frozen) once on the input images to estimate a camera and a depth map with per-pixel confidence for every view.
This geometry is an input of our multi-view transformer, but we first change the frame in which it is expressed: VGGT- Ω \Omega expresses its camera poses relative to the first view, whereas our model should treat all views symmetrically.
We therefore express all geometry in a common frame, the mean-frame : its origin is the mean of the camera centers, its forward axis the normalized mean of the viewing directions, its horizontal axis the mean of the cameras’ horizontal axes made orthogonal to the forward axis, and its vertical axis the cross product of the two.
No view is privileged in this frame, and for a single view it coincides with the camera frame.
The predicted normal n n is expressed in the mean-frame as well.

这种几何式是我国多视变速器的输入,但我们首先改变其表达的框架: VGGT - 组合\ Omega 表达相机相对于第一视图的显示, 而我们的模型应该对所有视图进行对称处理 。
因此,我们用一个共同的框架来表达所有几何:它的起源是相机中心的平均值,它的前轴是视线方向的规范化平均值,它的横向轴是相机的横向轴的平均值,它垂直轴是两者的交叉产物。
在这个帧中,没有视图是特权的,对于单一视图来说,它与相机帧是吻合的.

blocks.en:
The transformer computes one feature map per view from all images jointly, so that the features of a view combine evidence from all views.
We use the transformer of VGGT- Ω \Omega [ 90 ] , initialized from its released weights and fine-tuned, which alternates self-attention within each view (frame attention) and across all views (global attention) [ 89 ] .
Since a normal is decoded from a token pooled over several views, the features of every view must encode the pose of its camera in the mean-frame, which the image alone cannot provide.
We therefore give every pixel of a view ten geometry channels, all expressed in the mean-frame: its viewing ray in 6D Plücker coordinates [ 80 ] , the 3D point that VGGT- Ω \Omega estimates at that pixel, and the scalar log-confidence of this estimate.
An additional, zero-initialized patch embedding embeds these channels, and its output is added to the patch embedding of the image, so that the pretrained features are unchanged at initialization.
Further, VGGT- Ω \Omega marks its first view with separate camera and register tokens.
We drop the camera tokens and use the same register tokens for every view, making our transformer, unlike the frozen VGGT- Ω \Omega that estimates its input geometry, equivariant to the order of views.

Each intrinsic is decoded from z z by an individual two-layer MLP, followed by a sigmoid for albedo, roughness and metallicity, a softplus for irradiance which is predicted directly as log ⁡ ( 1 + e ) \log(1+e) , and a unit-length normalization for the normal.

blocks.en:
Nothing in Eq. 3 refers to the view from which a point is queried.
With a track obtained by projection, the locations, the weights and hence z z depend only on the point, the geometry and the images.
A surface point thus receives a single prediction from whichever view it is queried: its disagreement across views is zero by construction, without a consistency loss or fusion of per-view predictions.
Per-view maps are consistent up to a small disagreement, because corresponding pixels of two views do not query exactly the same point.
Even with exact geometry, the two pixels unproject to neighboring points, since each view samples the surface on its own pixel grid.
Errors in the estimated depth and cameras move them further apart and tilt the normals.
With a matcher, the two tracks also differ slightly, as each is matched from its own view.

blocks.en: 3.3 Training
blocks.zh: 3.3 培训

blocks.en:
Since the ground truth of our datasets comes as per-view maps, we train with pixel queries.
At each step, we sample query pixels in one view of every scene and supervise their intrinsics with the ground truth.
The tracks of these queries are drawn at random from three sources: projection with the ground-truth or VGGT- Ω \Omega ’s geometry, and the dense matcher RoMa- Ω \Omega [ 66 ] .
We apply an L 1 L_{1} loss on albedo, roughness, metallicity and log-irradiance, the cosine distance on the normal, and a multi-scale gradient loss [ 51 , 89 ] on queries sampled as 16 × 16 16\times 16 windows.
As rendered frames are exposed individually, we bring the irradiance labels of a set of views to one exposure, so that all views learn the same irradiance.
We neither compare the predictions of different views nor use visibility labels: the pooling of Eq. 3 has no learned parameters, so consistency holds by construction, not by learning.
We train on rendered scenes of Hypersim [ 70 ] , InteriorVerse [ 117 ] and three in-house datasets (1,400 in- and outdoor scenes), and on 1 1 M real photographs pseudo-labeled by a single-image model (see Sec. A.3 ).

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en:
We compare PointX with recent state-of-the-art methods in two settings.
In Sec. 4.1 , the geometry of the scene is given and we query its surface points directly.
In Secs. 4.2 and 4.3 , only the images are given: we query every pixel of every image and evaluate the consistency and the accuracy of the resulting per-view maps.
Finally, we present a set of key ablations in Sec. 4.4 and discuss applications in Sec. 4.5 .

最后,我们在第4.4节提出一套关键内容,并在第4.5节讨论各种应用。

We compare with single-view methods [ 41 , 103 , 67 ] , video models [ 55 , 20 , 85 ] , the multi-view models MVInverse [ 98 ] , MVID and MVID- Ω \Omega [ 14 ] , and GeoID [ 11 ] , a test-time multi-view consensus on RGB ↔ \leftrightarrow X [ 103 ] .
All use their released weights, and the video and multi-view models process several images jointly.
Methods that need posed images [ 73 ] or per-scene optimization [ 40 ] are not part of the main comparison.
We evaluate GenRecon [ 73 ] and Intrinsic Image Fusion [ 40 ] , on the task of Sec. 4.1 in Sec. C.2 .
We omit methods that target single objects [ 54 ] or have no released model [ 35 ] .

For accuracy, we report the PSNR of the albedo, as predicted and after fitting a per-channel scale to the ground truth (PSNR s {}_{\text{s}} ); the PSNR s {}_{\text{s}} of the irradiance, which is defined only up to the exposure of an image; the mean angular error of the normals; and the RMSE of roughness and metallicity.
The disagreement between two views is measured at corresponding points: we report the mean angle between their normals and, for the other properties, the RMSE between corresponding points divided by the RMSE between randomly paired ones (RMSE r {}_{\text{r}} , see appendix), so that a constant map is not rewarded.
An RMSE r {}_{\text{r}} of 0 0 means that the views agree, and an RMSE r {}_{\text{r}} of 1 1 that they agree no better than at random.

blocks.en: 4.1 Intrinsics of Surface Points
blocks.zh: 4.1 表面点的透镜

blocks.en: We first evaluate the task of Eq. 1 : predicting the intrinsics of a surface point from all the images in which it is visible.
blocks.zh: 我们首先评价Eq.1的任务:从所有可见的图像中预测一个表面点的内在特征.

blocks.en:
We use Hypersim and InteriorVerse, whose ground-truth depth gives the surface of every scene.
InteriorVerse provides no camera poses, so we register its views from the depth maps (see Appendix B ).
For every scene, we unproject the depth maps and sample surface points that are visible from at least two views.
We define the true value of a point to be the median of the ground-truth maps at its projections.
PointX is queried once per point, with its track and the confidence of Eq. 2 obtained by projection with the ground-truth geometry.
The baselines predict one map per view, so we read these maps at the projections of the point and take their unweighted mean over the views in which it is visible, using the same geometry; a weighted mean or a median gives similar results (see Sec. C.1 ).
blocks.zh:
我们使用Hypersim 和 InternalVerse, 它们的地面真相深度 提供了每个场景的表面。
InsideVerse没有提供相机姿势,所以我们从深度图中记录其观点(见附录B).
对于每个场景,我们解析至少从两个角度可见的深度地图和样品表面点.
我们确定一个点的真实价值,作为地面真实地图预测的中位数。
点X每点被询问一次,其轨迹和Eq.2的信心是通过地面真实几何的投影获得的。
基线预测每个视图的一张地图,因此我们在预测该点时阅读这些地图,并将其未加权的平均值取自可见的视图,使用相同的几何;加权的平均值或中位值得出类似的结果(见Sec. C.1 )。

blocks.en:
Table 1 shows that PointX is the most accurate on every property of InteriorVerse and competitive with the most accurate baselines on Hypersim.
Averaging the maps that PointX predicts for each view without pooling gives nearly the same accuracy, but at the cost of consistency.
Every baseline assigns different values to the same surface point in different views, so its predictions must be fused before they can be attached to the scene.
As observed in Fig. 3 , where there is disagreement, seams appear on the baselines’ intrinsic point clouds.
PointX decodes the intrinsics of every point once, which yields uniform surfaces.
blocks.zh:
表1显示,PointX在Hypersim的每个地产上是最准确的,与最准确的基线具有竞争力.
使用PointX为每个视图预测的地图而不集合,给出的准确度几乎相同,但以一致性为代价.
每个基线在不同观点中为同一个表面点分配不同的值,因此其预测必须被熔化后才能附着在现场.
如图3所示,如果存在分歧,则在基线的内在点云上出现缝合物。
点 X解码每点一次的内在,产生统一的表面.

blocks.en: 4.2 Consistency of Per-View Maps
blocks.zh: 4.2 照片的一致性

blocks.en:
The geometry of a scene is often unknown, and many applications expect one map per image.
We hence measure next whether a method’s per-view maps agree at ground-truth correspondences.
blocks.zh:
一个场景的几何往往未知,许多应用程序期望每个图像有一个地图.
因此,我们接下来衡量一种方法的逐景地图是否在地面真实的通信中一致。

blocks.en:
We apply the reprojection protocol of MVInverse [ 98 ] to the real photographs of ETH3D, whose laser scans give exact correspondences.
For every pair of views, the pixels of one view are projected into the other with the ground-truth depth and kept where the depth of the other view confirms that they are visible.
The maps of the two views are compared at these corresponding pixels, with the normals rotated into the world frame by the ground-truth cameras.
Additional results are in the appendix.
blocks.zh:
我们把MVINVERS [98]的再投影协议应用于ETH3D的真实照片,其激光扫描给出了精确的对应.
对于每一对视图,一个视图的像素以地面真实深度投射到另一个视图中,并保留在另一个视图的深度证实它们可见的地方.
这两个视图的地图在这些对应的像素上进行了比较,正常的由地面真相机旋转进入世界框架.
其他结果载于附录。

blocks.en:
Table 2 shows that PointX is the most consistent on all five properties with the tracks of a dense matcher, RoMa- Ω \Omega .
In Fig. 4 , the marked surface point looks different in the two views, and the baselines assign it a different albedo in each view, whereas PointX’s predictions look the most similar and have the lowest difference.
The video and multi-view baselines process the views jointly but still decode each view separately, which does not ensure consistency.
In PointX, corresponding pixels are decoded from tokens pooled along nearly identical tracks, so their predictions can differ only as much as their tracks do ( Sec. 3.2 ).
Its consistency therefore improves with the precision of the tracks, without retraining.
With tracks projected through the coarser geometry of VGGT- Ω \Omega , it already leads on irradiance, normals and roughness.
The matcher extends the lead to all four properties.
When ground-truth geometry is available, its exact tracks make PointX highly consistent, with by far the lowest disagreement on every property.
blocks.zh:
表2显示 PointX 在所有五个属性中最一致的是一个密钥匹配器的音轨, RoMa - ship =\Omega 。
在图4中,标记的表面点在两种观点中看起来不同,基线在每种观点中都给出了不同的反照率,而PointQQs的预测看起来最相似,差别最小.

Without the geometry channels, we observe in Tab. 4 a that every property becomes less accurate and less consistent.
The normals degrade the most: they are expressed in the mean-frame, so the model must infer the orientation of each camera from the images alone, and any error in it tilts all the normals of that view (see Sec. C.5 ).

没有几何通道,我们用Tab观察. 4 a,每个财产的准确性降低,一致性降低。

With global attention restricted to each view, the views interact only through pooling.
In Tab. 4 a, this variant remains as accurate from one image, but improves far less with more images, and its maps disagree more.
Encoding the views jointly thus turns additional views into accuracy gains ( Fig. 5 ) and aligns the tokens of a surface point across views, which pooling alone does not.

由于全球注意力仅限于每个视图,观点只能通过集合来互动.

因此,将各种观点合并编码,将其他观点转化为准确性增益(图5),使各种观点之间的表面点的符号一致,而光靠这些观点并不集中。

The confidence of Eq. 2 down-weights the views in which a point is occluded.

4.5 Applications
blocks.zh: 4.5 申请

blocks.en:
Since PointX predicts one set of intrinsics per surface point, its predictions attach directly to a 3D representation of the scene, with no per-view maps to fuse.
In Fig. 1 , we query every point of the laser scan of an ETH3D scene once to obtain an intrinsic point cloud.
A new light or an albedo edit applied in 3D then changes every photograph consistently, since each surface point is modified once (see Appendix D ).
In Fig. 6 , we instead query one point per texel of a mesh, which bakes the predictions into its textures.
The result is a standard asset for physically based rendering: a path tracer renders it under a new light with the predicted materials, and an inserted chrome ball reflects the textured scene.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We introduce PointX, a simple feed-forward model that predicts the intrinsic properties of any queried surface point from one or more images of a scene.
Our core insight is that intrinsics belong to the surface points of a scene, not to the pixels of an image.
PointX therefore pools the evidence of all views in which a point is visible into a single token and decodes its intrinsics once, making each point’s prediction consistent across views by construction.
Its per-view maps achieve state-of-the-art consistency on real scenes, and their accuracy, competitive from a single image, improves with every added view to lead on most metrics.
PointX also predicts the intrinsics of point clouds and meshes, for view-consistent relighting, editing and object insertion.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了PointX,一个简单的向导模型,从一个场景的一个或多个图像中预测任何被询问的表面点的内在属性.
我们的核心见解是,内在属于一个场景的表面点,而不是图像的像素.
点 因此,X将所有观点中一个点可见的证据汇集到一个单一的符号中,并将它的内在内容解码一次,使每个点的预测通过构建来表达各种观点。
它的逐景图在真实场景上实现了最先进的一致性,其准确性,从单一的图像中具有竞争力,随着每一个新增的视图而改进,以领先于大多数的度量衡.
点 X还预测点云和 meshes 的内在性,用于视线一致的重燃,编辑和对象插入.

blocks.en: We complement Sec. 3 with further details on the architecture, the training procedure and the training data, in the notation of the main paper.

blocks.en: A.1 Architecture
blocks.zh: A.1 建筑结构

blocks.en:
The transformer is initialized from the released 1B-parameter checkpoint of VGGT- Ω \Omega [ 90 ] : a DINOv3 ViT-L/16 patch encoder [ 77 ] followed by 24 frame-attention and 24 global-attention blocks of width 1024 in alternation.
The DPT decoder [ 68 ] follows the dense head of VGGT- Ω \Omega without its output layer and is trained from scratch.
It fuses the tokens of four transformer blocks into a feature map at 1 / 4 1/4 of the image resolution, and two further upsampling stages bring it to the full resolution, each with a skip connection from the first two convolution blocks of an ImageNet-pretrained VGG19 [ 78 ] .
The decoder feature has 128 channels and the tokens have 256 dimensions.
blocks.zh:
变压器从VGGT-ship \Omega [90] 的释放的1B参数检查点初始化:一个 DINOv3 ViT-L/16 补丁编码器 [77],然后是24个帧注意和24个宽度1024的全局注意区块.
DPT 解码器 [68] 遵循 VGGT- complete \ Omega 的密钥头,没有输出层,并从零开始训练.
它将4个变压器块的符号熔化成图像分辨率的1/4 1/4的特征图,另外两个更新的阶段将它带到了完全的分辨率,每个阶段都有一个从ImageNet预装的VGG19的前两个变压器块的跳过连接[78].
解码器的特性有128个频道,信使有256个维度.

blocks.en: For the tracks of RoMa- Ω \Omega [ 66 ] , we use its fast setting and take its predicted overlap probability as the confidence of the matcher.
blocks.zh: 对于 RoMa- ship \ Omega [66] 的音轨, 我们使用它的快速设置, 并将其预测的重合概率作为匹配者的信心 。

blocks.en:
Each head is a two-layer MLP with a hidden width of 1024 and a GELU between its two layers; its output passes through the activation given in Sec. 3.2 .
In total, PointX has 999M trainable parameters: 911M in the transformer, 87M in the decoder and 1.3M in the heads.
The frozen VGGT- Ω \Omega that estimates the input geometry and RoMa- Ω \Omega are not counted.

blocks.en: A.2 Training
blocks.zh: A.2 培训

blocks.en:
Each GPU holds 24 images per step, as ⌊ 24 / N ⌋ \lfloor 24/N\rfloor sets of N N views, with N N drawn from 2 to 24; with probability 0.1, a step instead holds 24 unrelated photographs, each a set of a single view.
A multi-view set consists of frames of one camera trajectory: either a run of frames at a random stride, or a random frame together with frames that are close to it in camera pose.
blocks.zh:
每个GPU每步持有24幅图像,作为QQ 24 / N \ lloet 24/N\rroleds集的N N视图,N N从2到24绘制;如果概率为0.1,一个步骤而是持有24张不相关的照片,每集是一组单一的视图.
多视图套装由一个相机轨迹的帧组成:要么在随机速度下运行一圈帧,要么在相机姿势下与它相近的帧一起随机帧.

blocks.en:
Images are resized and cropped to a width of 512 px and to a random aspect ratio between 0.33 and 1 that is shared by all images of a step, and each set is mirrored horizontally with probability 0.5.
With probability 0.5, the input images of a set are degraded by a random combination of blur, downsampling, noise and JPEG compression, while their labels are left unchanged.

在概率0.5下,一个集的输入图像通过模糊,下采样,噪音和JPEG压缩的随机组合而退化,而其标签则保持不变.

blocks.en:
Each step draws 16,384 16{,}384 query pixels per GPU, all in one randomly chosen view of each set.
Half of them form the 16 × 16 16\times 16 windows of the gradient loss.
We draw 10 % 10\% of the queries on metallic surfaces, 27 % 27\% near depth discontinuities and the rest uniformly.
The source of the tracks is drawn uniformly among the three sources of Sec. 3.3 at every step; where a dataset provides no ground-truth cameras or depth, the geometry of VGGT- Ω \Omega takes the place of the ground truth.

其中一半构成16×16 16\时的渐变损失16个窗口.
我们在金属表面抽取10%的查询, 27%的查询接近深度不连续,其余的则一致。
轨迹的源头在每一步第3.3节的三个来源之间划出;如果数据集没有提供地面对齐的摄像头或深度,VGGT-ship==Omega的几何来取代地面的真相。

blocks.en:
The losses of the five properties are summed with equal weights.
The gradient loss is an L 1 L_{1} loss on the finite differences of prediction and label within each window, at four scales that each subsample the window by two.
Metallic surfaces are rare, so within the metallicity loss, the queries on them are up-weighted by their inverse frequency, capped at 2.
In addition to the queries, the pixels of every view on a grid of stride 4 are decoded from their own token alone and supervised with the same losses, with weight 0.5.
Each loss is applied only where its label is valid: the dataset must provide the property ( Tab. 5 ) and define it at the pixel, which excludes, e.g . , the normal of the sky and the irradiance of saturated pixels.
blocks.zh:
五物财产损失以等重相加.
梯度损失是每个窗口内预测和标签的有限差异的L 1 LQQQ1}损失,在4个尺度上,每个尺度对窗口进行2个子样本.
金属表面很少见,因此在金属损耗范围内,其上的查询量被反向频率提升,封顶为2.
除查询外,每条网格上各处景色的像素均从自己的标语中单独解码,并监督损失相同,重量0.5.
每个丢失仅在其标签有效的情况下才适用:数据集必须提供属性(Tab. 5),并在像素上定义,它排除了例如天空的正常和饱和像素的辐射.

blocks.en:
Where frames are exposed individually, the irradiance label of a surface point differs between two views by the ratio of their exposures.
We estimate this ratio as the median ratio of the labels over the surface points that both views observe, which we find with the ground-truth geometry, solve for the exposure of every view of a set by least squares, and divide its labels by it.
The common exposure of a set remains arbitrary: we fit one scale between prediction and label per set in closed form before the L 1 L_{1} loss, and penalize its logarithm with weight 0.1.
Where the views cannot be related, as for single photographs, the scale is fitted per image.
blocks.zh:
当帧单独暴露时,表面点的辐照标签会根据其暴露比例在两种观点之间有所区别.
我们估计这个比率是两种观点所观察到的表面点上的标签的中位数比率,我们用地面-真实几何来发现,用最小的方块来解决一个集合的每个视图的曝光问题,并用它来划分标签。
一组的常见暴露仍然是任意的:在L1 LQQ1]损失之前,我们按每组封闭式的预测和标签进行一个尺度,并以重量0.1来惩罚其对数。
在视图无法关联的情况下,与单一照片一样,每张图像都配有比例尺。

blocks.en:
We use AdamW [ 60 ] ( β = ( 0.9 , 0.95 ) \beta=(0.9,0.95) , weight decay 0.05), bfloat16 mixed precision, gradient clipping at an L 2 L^{2} norm of 10, and an exponential moving average of the parameters with decay 0.999, which is the model we evaluate.
PointX is trained with the losses above for 70 70 k steps, with 5 5 k warm-up steps to a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} and a cosine decay to 10 − 5 10^{-5} .
Training takes approximately 5 5 days to complete on 8 A100 80GB GPUs.

blocks.en:
In Sec. 4 , we omit methods that need posed images or per-scene optimization.
Since the task of Sec. 4.1 provides the cameras and the geometry of every scene, we evaluate two of them on it: Intrinsic Image Fusion [ 40 ] and GenRecon [ 73 ] . Table 7 shows that PointX is considerably more accurate than both on every property of InteriorVerse.
On Hypersim, it is more accurate than GenRecon, while Intrinsic Image Fusion builds on RGB ↔ \leftrightarrow X [ 103 ] , which was trained on the test scenes. Figure 10 shows two scenes.
blocks.zh:
在第4节中,我们省略了需要呈现图像或每个场景优化的方法。
由于Sec 4.1的任务提供了每个场景的摄像头和几何特征,我们评价了其中的两个场景:Intrinsic Image Fusion [40]和GenRecon [73]. 表7显示,在内政部的所有财产上,第X点都比这两个点准确得多。
在Hypersim上,它比GenRecon更准确,而Intrinsic Image Fusion则基于RGB QQ\\右旋X [103],在测试场景上接受了训练. 图10显示两个场景。

blocks.en:
Intrinsic Image Fusion draws samples of RGB ↔ \leftrightarrow X for every view, fuses them into one material field on a mesh of the scene, and refines this field by inverse path tracing.
We give it the ground-truth cameras, the ground-truth depth maps as its mesh, and the instance segmentation it requires, from SAM 2 [ 69 ] masks that we link across views with the ground-truth depth.
GenRecon generates a mesh with material textures from posed images and sparse scene points, for which we use the ground-truth cameras and points of the ground-truth depth maps.
The result of each method is rendered into the views of a set and scored like the maps of the other baselines.
Intrinsic Image Fusion optimizes a set for more than one hour on an A100 GPU and GenRecon takes about ten minutes, whereas PointX takes seconds ( Sec. 4.4 ).

内向图像融合为每个视图绘制RGB QQ\\右旋X的样本,在场景的网格上将其熔化成一个物质场,并通过反向路径跟踪来完善这个场景.
我们从SAM 2 [69] 口罩中向它提供地面真实摄像头,地面真实深度图作为其网格,以及它所需要的实例分解,我们把各种观点与地面真实深度联系起来。
GenRecon从摆放的图像和稀疏的场景点产生含有物质纹理的网格,为此我们使用地面真实相机和地面真实深度图的点.
每种方法的结果被转换成一组的视角,并像其他基线的地图一样得分。
在A100 GPU和GenRecon上,Intrinsic Image Fusion对一个集进行一个多小时的优化,大约需要10分钟,而PointX则需要数秒(sec. 4.4).

blocks.en:
The fusion makes the samples of RGB ↔ \leftrightarrow X about as consistent as the ground-truth maps ( Tab. 1 ), but it does not correct them: its accuracy remains that of RGB ↔ \leftrightarrow X.
The inverse path tracing explains the images by the light that the surfaces of the mesh exchange.
Its authors evaluate it on scenes covered by about 200 views, whereas our sets hold eight views of a part of a scene, so much of this light comes from surfaces that no view shows.
The optimization compensates for the missing light with a brighter albedo, which saturates on Hypersim.
On InteriorVerse, it improves the metallicity but degrades the roughness and the PSNR s {}_{\text{s}} of the albedo.
On one of the scenes of its authors, its released pipeline raises the albedo PSNR of the fusion from 15.0 to 22.6 dB with all 202 views, and not at all with eight of them.

blocks.en:
GenRecon is a generative reconstruction model, and its authors evaluate its geometry only.
Its materials are sampled from a 3D generative prior conditioned on the images: they look plausible but are far from the true ones.
Its mesh also deviates from the true surface, in particular on Hypersim, where a set often shows only a part of a large room, so the renders of this one mesh still disagree at the true surface points.
blocks.zh:
GenRecon是一个基因重建模型,其作者仅评价其几何学.
其材料从图像上预先设定的三维基因样本中取样:它们看起来是可信的,但远非真实的。
它的网格也偏离了真实的表面,特别是在Hypersim上,一个集往往只显示一个大房间的一部分,因此这个网格的成份在真实的表面点上仍然有分歧.

blocks.en: C.4 Accuracy of Per-View Maps
blocks.zh: C.4 照片精确度

blocks.en:
Figure 12 repeats the experiment of Fig. 5 on Hypersim.
The views of a set are split into consecutive groups of N N views that are predicted independently, so that every view is predicted from N N images and the same views are scored for every N N .
As on InteriorVerse, every property predicted by PointX becomes more accurate with more images, MVInverse gains considerably less, and the gain remains without pooling.

图12重复了Hypersim上的图5的实验.
一个集的视图被分割成连续一组独立预测的N N视图,这样每个视图都从N N图像中预测,每个N N 的相同视图都得分.

blocks.en: C.5 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: C.5 阅读研究

blocks.en:
Without the geometry channels, the model must infer the orientation of each camera in the mean-frame from the images alone ( Sec. 4.4 ). Figure 13 shows a set where this fails: view 8 shares little content with the other views, and its normals are predicted in a wrong orientation.
With the geometry channels, the normals of all views are oriented correctly.
In most sets the effect is smaller, a slight tilt of the normals of individual views.
blocks.zh:
没有几何通道,模型必须仅从图像中推断出每台中间框镜头的方向(第4.4节)。 图13显示了一个该失败的集合:视图8与其他视图分享的内容很少,其常态以错误的方向预测.
通过几何通道,所有观点的常态方向正确.
在大多数设定中,效果较小,个别观点的常态略微倾斜.

Let L L be the product of the predicted albedo and irradiance of a point, i.e . , its diffuse radiance under the original illumination.
We dim it and add the radiance L new L_{\text{new}} of the point under new point lights, computed with a Cook–Torrance model [ 10 ] from its predicted albedo, roughness, metallicity and normal: L ′ = k ​ L + L new L^{\prime}=kL+L_{\text{new}} , with k < 1 k<1 .
Each photograph is then multiplied, in linear RGB, by L ′ / L L^{\prime}/L at the pixels to which the points project.

让L成为一个点的预测反照率和辐照率的产物,即在原光照下它的扩散光度.
我们淡化并添加新点的亮度 L + 新的 L + 文本{ new} , 用 Cook - Torrance 模型 [10] 计算出其预测反照率、粗糙度、金属度和正常度: L ' = k L + L 新的 L + + primeme + k L+ + + + 文本{ new + , 加上 k < 1 k < 1 。
然后,每张照片以线性RGB乘以L ' /L L^{\prime}/L,以点数工程的像素表示。

blocks.en: Appendix E Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 附录E 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en:
PointX locates a surface point through the geometry or the matches it is given, so their errors carry over to its predictions.
With the geometry estimated by VGGT- Ω \Omega [ 90 ] , its per-view maps are less consistent than with the tracks of RoMa- Ω \Omega [ 66 ] or with ground-truth geometry ( Tab. 2 ), and an error in an estimated camera tilts the normals of its view.
RoMa- Ω \Omega in turn matches every pair of views, so its cost grows quadratically with their number.
Since the tracks are an input, PointX benefits from any progress in reconstruction and matching without retraining.
blocks.zh:
点 X通过几何或给定的匹配来定位一个表面点,所以它们的误差会传到它的预测.
由于VGGT- complete \ Omega [90] 估计的几何,其每幅视图图与RoMa- complete [66] 的轨迹或地面对接几何(Tab. 2)的轨迹不太一致,估计相机的误差会使其视图的正常倾斜.
RoMa- 组合\ Omega 依次匹配每对视图, 因此其成本与它们的数量成倍增长 。
由于音轨是一种投入,PointX从重建和配对方面的任何进展中受益而无需再培训.

blocks.en:
The weights of Eq. 3 have no learned parameters and depend only on the visibility of a point.
They make the prediction of a point independent of the view, but not smooth along a surface: neighboring points that are visible in different sets of views are decoded from different sets of tokens, which can leave a small step between their predictions, e.g . , where the frame of another image ends.
A confidence that also decreases towards the border of an image is a simple extension that we leave for future work.
blocks.zh:
Eq. 3的权重没有学到的参数,只取决于一个点的能见度.
它们对一个独立于视图的点进行预测,但沿表面不平滑:在不同的一组观点中可见的邻位点从不同的几组符号中解码,这可以在它们的预测之间留下一个小步骤,例如,另一个图像的框架结束的地方.
信心在形象边界上也会减少,这是我们留给未来工作的简单延伸。

blocks.en:
On Hypersim, PointX does not reach the most accurate baseline on albedo and irradiance ( Tabs. 1 and 3 ).
Part of this gap is the overall scale of the albedo, i.e . , the difference between PSNR and PSNR s {}_{\text{s}} , and it remains when more views are added.
Views of a scene under the same illumination add evidence about its surfaces, but not about how their brightness divides into albedo and irradiance.
PointX also assumes a static scene whose illumination does not change between the images.
Images captured under varying illumination could provide the missing evidence and are an interesting direction.
blocks.zh:
在 Hypersim 上,点 X没有达到反照率和辐照率的最准确基线(标签1和3)。
这一差距的一部分是反照率的整体尺度,即PSNR和PSNR s QQText{s}}}的区别,在添加更多视图时它仍然存在.
在同一光照下对一个场景的观察会增加关于其表面的证据,但不能说明其亮度如何分为反照率和辐照度.
点 X还假设一个静态场景,其照明在图像之间没有变化.
在各种照明下捕获的图像可以提供缺失的证据,是一个有趣的方向。

blocks.en:
All multi-view supervision comes from rendered scenes: the real photographs are single images with pseudo-labels, and they carry no roughness or metallicity ( Tab. 5 ).
On real scenes, we evaluate the accuracy of the albedo and the consistency of all five properties, but not the accuracy of the other properties.
Real multi-view captures with measured materials would benefit both training and evaluation.
blocks.zh:
所有多视图监督都来自渲染的场景:真实的照片是带有伪标签的单一图像,它们没有粗糙度或金属度(Tab.5 ).
在真实的场景中,我们评价反照率的准确性,以及所有五个属性的一致性,但不评价其他属性的准确性.
以计量材料进行真正的多观点捕捉将有益于培训和评价。

blocks.en:
PointX encodes all images of a scene in one forward pass and is trained with up to 24 views.
Its consistency holds by construction within such a set of images. Extending the pooling across sets, for long videos or large scenes, is left for future work.
blocks.zh:
点 X将一个场景的所有图像编码在一个前传中,并接受最多24个视图的训练.
它的一致性通过构建在这样一套图像中。 为长视频或大型场景而扩大集成,留待未来工作。
